_global.retrieval_method: apextraderfunding.com and support.apextraderfunding.com both hard-block automated fetch (Cloudflare error 1020 / 403 to WebFetch, curl and headless Chromium). Every value below comes from Apex's OWN pages read through Wayback Machine snapshots; snapshot timestamps are given per record.
_global.product_lineup_change: Apex retired its entire previous lineup on 2026-03-01. Only two variants are purchasable now (EOD Drawdown, Intraday Trailing Drawdown) in 4 sizes (25K/50K/100K/150K). 75K, 250K, 300K and the 100K STATIC product are LEGACY - not purchasable, still tradeable by existing holders under frozen rules.
_global.no_static_variant_on_sale: There is NO static-drawdown product on sale as of 2026-07-24. The closest current analogue is the EOD Drawdown variant (threshold fixed for the whole session, recalculated at the close).
_global.AUTOMATION_PROHIBITED: Apex prohibits automation and algorithmic execution in ALL phases: 'No Automation or Algorithm Usage allowed... not to reward automated systems executing preprogrammed logic.' Repeated verbatim in the Live program rules. Also bans HFT and manipulation of the sim environment. This is a hard constraint for any automated-strategy plan on Apex.
_global.platform_dependency: The evaluation drawdown-lock behaviour DIFFERS BY DATA VENDOR. Rithmic and WealthCharts evals lock the threshold at the profit-target balance; Tradovate evals trail forever. PA behaviour (lock at start+$100) is the same on all vendors.
_global.session: trading day 18:00:00-16:59:59 ET (Sun 18:00 open counts as Monday); all positions flat and pending orders cancelled before 16:59 ET daily close
_global.micro_ratio_note: 10 micro contracts = 1 mini contract for all exposure limits, all phases.
_global.instruments: CME/CBOT/NYMEX/COMEX equity, FX, ag, energy, metal, micro futures + MBT/MET; EUREX only on Tradovate.
_global._schema_note: Each variant has a _defaults object. Full record for a (phase,variant,size) = {**variant['_defaults'], **variant['sizes'][size]}. Fields absent from both are null/UNVERIFIED.
_global.dd_two_axis_note: hwm_basis = what ratchets the floor upward. breach_basis = what is tested against the floor. Apex matches MFF/Topstep/TPT: breach is ALWAYS real-time equity including unrealized P&L, in every sim phase; only the ratchet cadence differs (EOD variant ratchets on the close, Intraday variant ratchets on peak equity). Live phase breach_basis is UNVERIFIED.

TRAILING_STOP_POINT.pa_all_variants_all_vendors: START BALANCE + $100 (NOT relative to the profit target)
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.pa_verbatim: Once the Intraday Threshold reaches Starting Balance + $100, it stops increasing. Example for a 50K Intraday PA: Threshold Stop Level = $50,100. This occurs when the highest balance, whether realized or unrealized, reaches $52,100 (Starting Balance + Max Drawdown + $100). From that point onward, the Intraday Threshold remains fixed at $50,100.
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.pa_verbatim_eod_twin: Once the EOD Threshold reaches Starting Balance + $100, it stops increasing. Example for a 50K EOD PA: Threshold Stop Level = $50,100. This occurs when the Highest EOD Balance reaches $52,100 (Starting Balance + Max Drawdown + $100).
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.eval_rithmic_wealthcharts: PROFIT TARGET BALANCE (relative to the target, NOT the start balance) - this is the opposite basis from the PA
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.eval_verbatim: Intraday Threshold stops trailing and becomes fixed when it reaches an amount equal to the Target Profit balance. Example for a 50K Rithmic and Wealthcharts Intraday Evaluation account: Threshold Stop Level = $53.000. This occurs when the highest balance, whether realized or unrealized, reaches $55,000 (Profit Target Balance + Max Drawdown). From that point onward, the Intraday Threshold remains fixed at $53,000.
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.eval_tradovate_verbatim: Evaluations Tradovate: Intraday Drawdown trails indefinitely with the peak account balance.
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.legacy_pa_verbatim: the trailing drawdown follows your peak unrealized balance until it reaches a fixed point, which is called the Safety Net (initial balance + drawdown limit + $100). The trailing drawdown stops moving when your peak unrealized account balance reaches the Safety Net.
TRAILING_STOP_POINT.SELF_CONTRADICTION_ON_APEX_PAGE: The Intraday FAQ on the same page says 'trailing stops once the Intraday Threshold reaches Profit Target Balance + $2,000' - that sentence is wrong/sloppy. Its own worked numbers ($53,000 threshold, locking when balance hits $55,000) agree with the body text, not with the sentence. Model the body text.

breach_basis_verbatim.intraday: The threshold follows the account's highest intraday balance (Peak Balance). ... The threshold is enforced in real time, including unrealized PnL.
breach_basis_verbatim.eod_pa: Your account balance, including unrealized PnL, may never touch or fall below the End-of-Day (EOD) Drawdown threshold. If it does, all positions are automatically liquidated and the PA is permanently closed.
breach_basis_verbatim.eod_enforcement: Even though the threshold is calculated at end-of-day, it is enforced in real time.
breach_basis_verbatim.legacy: the trailing threshold is based on the highest live value during trades, not on closed trade values.
